title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to MrBeast?
description:
Seven real photos connect Adolf Hitler to MrBeast, through Mussolini, Turkey's wartime leader, Churchill, the Queen, Trump and Ronaldo.

Adolf Hitler → Benito Mussolini → İsmet İnönü → Winston Churchill → Elizabeth II → Donald Trump → Cristiano Ronaldo → MrBeast

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Mussolini: In 1940, Hitler rode through Munich with his ally, Benito Mussolini, the dictator of Italy.
   Photo by Eva Braun, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hitler_and_Mussolini_June_1940.jpg
2. Mussolini → Ismet Inonu: In 1932, Turkey's prime minister, Ismet Inonu, came to Rome for talks with Mussolini.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ismet_pacha,_ministre_des_affaires_%C3%A9trang%C3%A8res_de_Turquie,_Mussolini,_Ruscdy_Bey_-_btv1b9051855q.jpg
3. Ismet Inonu → Winston Churchill: In 1943, Inonu flew to Cairo, where Winston Churchill begged Turkey to join the war.
   Photo by U.S. Army Signal Corps, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Roosevelt_In%C3%B6n%C3%BC_and_Churchill_in_Cairo_cph.3b15312.jpg
4. Winston Churchill → Queen Elizabeth II: In 1953, Churchill was prime minister to the newly crowned Queen Elizabeth.
   Photo by Official photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Churchill_queen_Elizabeth_1953.jpg
5. Queen Elizabeth II → Donald Trump: In 2018, the Queen welcomed Donald Trump to Windsor Castle.
   Photo by Office of U.S. First Lady, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Trumps_with_Elizabeth_II_in_2018.jpg
6. Donald Trump → Ronaldo: In 2025, Trump hosted Cristiano Ronaldo in the Oval Office.
   Photo by The White House, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Donald_Trump_meets_with_Cristiano_Ronaldo_in_the_Oval_Office_(54934459299).jpg
7. Ronaldo → MrBeast: And in 2024, Ronaldo filmed a video with MrBeast.
   Photo by MrBeast (Instagram), via The News International, Fair use (commentary): https://jang.com.pk/en/26212-mrbeast-and-cristiano-ronaldo-spark-excitement-with-big-announcement-news

Research notes: Nearly every free photo of Mussolini shows people who died in the 1940s, so the way out to today runs through the Turkish leader he welcomed to Rome in 1932, who lived until 1973 and sat beside Churchill in Cairo.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #mrbeast #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment:
Fun fact from the research: Churchill spent 1943 trying to drag Turkey into the war against Hitler. Turkey held out and only declared war in February 1945.

Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
